title: TrustRadius Review Scraper
description: Scrape verified B2B software reviews from TrustRadius. Provide a product URL (e.g. https://www.trustradius.com/products/apify/reviews/all) to extract all reviews.

startUrl.title: Product Review URL
startUrl.description: Full TrustRadius product or reviews URL (e.g. https://www.trustradius.com/products/slack/reviews/all)

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of reviews
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of reviews to collect

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional fallback proxy. The actor tries the stable direct API first and only uses proxy fallback when this is enabled.
